agents.name: Data preparation
agents.method: Validated sales and outlet data; numeric gaps use column medians, following the source notebook. Duplicates removed by outlet and month.

agents.name: Outlet benchmarking
agents.method: Weighted normalized peer KPIs across the full source period.

agents.name: Performance score
agents.method: Seven ranked drivers; Excellent ≥80, Good ≥65, Needs Improvement ≥50.

agents.name: Outlet performance agent
agents.method: Explainable outlet insights using profit, conversion, satisfaction and complaints.

agents.name: Demand forecasting
agents.method: Three preceding months, excluding the current month; first three estimates are unavailable. The source column says next month, but the supplied algorithm is a lagged estimate.

agents.name: Inventory agent
agents.method: Stock, freshness and replenishment rules. Uses the forecast supplied in the inventory workbook.

agents.name: Staff agent
agents.method: Retention and service signals, with employee trends from the enhanced workforce branch.

agents.name: Workforce analytics
agents.method: Validated combined workbook: productivity, attendance and scheduling.

agents.name: Marketing agent
agents.method: Marketing spend, revenue efficiency and effectiveness using the team agent.

agents.name: Marketing effectiveness
agents.method: Campaign ROI, reach, conversion and engagement from the combined workbook.

agents.name: Operational insights
agents.method: Recent three months versus previous three months; weighted operational risks.

agents.name: Cross-functional health
agents.method: Combines workforce, marketing and latest inventory coverage by Outlet_ID.
